title: OpenAI’s letter to Governor Newsom on harmonized regulation
summary: We’ve just sent a letter to Gov. Gavin Newsom calling for California to lead the way in harmonizing state-based AI regulation with national—and, by virtue of US leadership, emerging global—standards.
body: We’ve just sent a letter to Gov. Gavin Newsom calling for California to lead the way in harmonizing state-based AI regulation with national—and, by virtue of US leadership, emerging global—standards.
summaryZh: OpenAI向加州州长加文·纽森发送公开信，呼吁加州带头推动州级AI监管政策与国家及全球新兴标准相协调。原始信息显示：We’ve just sent a letter to Gov. Gavin Newsom calling for California to lead the way in harmonizing state-based AI regulation with national—and, by virtue of US leadership, emerging global—standards.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI’s letter to Governor Newsom on harmonized regulation”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI致信加州州长，呼吁将州级AI监管与国家和全球标准进行统一协调。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
